crossRefs.note: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
Then Yahweh’s angel stretched out the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the meat and the unleavened…
For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah…
Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, then he vanished out of their sight.

translations.web: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
translations.bsb: Then God went up from the place where He had spoken with him.
translations.kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked
translations.asv: And God went up from him in the place where he spake with him.
